name: Dynamic Range Evidence Authority Fix
changes: Fixes same-tier 2160p upgrade rejection when release-name provenance says Dolby Vision/HDR but the imported media probe proves the current file does not actually contain those dynamic-range traits.

Separates release provenance from intrinsic media evidence: WEB-DL/WEBRip and release-group identity remain provenance-driven, while a successful current-file media probe is authoritative for Dolby Vision, HDR10+, and HDR presence.
Allows a real Dolby Vision-only candidate to upgrade an SDR 2160p WEB-DL current file, and allows Dolby Vision + HDR fallback to upgrade a true Dolby Vision-only current file.
Keeps a current file that actually probes as Dolby Vision + HDR fallback terminal even if its original release name omitted those traits.
Preserves the v3.6.86 one-snapshot-per-operation Automation and Interactive Search performance fix without reintroducing repeated media-quality-cache reads.

Preserves v3.6.84 1080p Balanced Allow semantics, source refinement behavior, Newsgroup Browser tuning, SABnzbd 5.1.2, Metadata Server v0.3.3, Diagnostic Collector v1.0.31, and guarded publication topology.
regression_guards: Current-file media probe can correct stale/optimistic release-title DV/HDR claims without discarding provenance-only source/release-group metadata.
SDR current 2160p WEB-DL accepts Dolby Vision-only and Dolby Vision + HDR fallback same-tier candidates as dynamic range improves.
True Dolby Vision-only current media still accepts Dolby Vision + HDR fallback, while actual DV+HDR remains terminal.
v3.6.86 Automation summary and Interactive Search cache-snapshot performance behavior remains guarded.
Frozen Newsgroup Browser, yEnc, download, SAB, Metadata Server, and Diagnostic Collector boundaries remain guarded.
